title: tc-results-list
description:
Search results to read and open – kind, title, a snippet with the query's words marked, source and date; grouped by
kind, sorted by relevance or date, "Did you mean", Show more and loading rows.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

query.description: What was searched for; its words are picked out in titles and snippets

results.description: The results, in order of relevance

group.description: Group results under their kind, or list them as they come

suggestion.description: "Did you mean …" – a corrected query to offer

total.description: How many there are in all, in words ("About 1,240 results"); by default the count of `results`

sort.description: The order. Changed by the user unless a tc-sort-change listener calls preventDefault()

selected.description: The result in focus. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

pageSize.description: How many show at first, and how many Show more adds

hasMore.description: There are more than `results` holds: Show more stays, for the page to load them (tc-more)

locale.description: The language for dates and numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

snippet.description: A passage that shows why it matched; the query's words are picked out

kind.description: What it is – "Document", "Person", "Email" or any word; results are grouped by it

source.description: Where it lives – a folder, a site, a mailbox

href.description: Where it opens; a title without one is a button (tc-open)

date.description: When it was made or changed, epoch ms

score.description: How well it matched, 0–1, for the page's own use

meta.description: More words for the quiet line under the snippet
